digest.component_or_area: plan review signing and manifest generation
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin per direct child and prerequisite, with role, canonical ticket ID, and 16-hex material fingerprint in lexicographically sorted order.
PlanRelationSnapshot must compile one store-wide ticket_states_by_id preload including archived states to discover arbitrary inbound blockers without calling find_inbound_relationships.

Any unreadable or unresolvable target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with a structured ERROR record before any LLM evaluation begins, with reason from exactly {missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure}.

tracker_head_sha() must verify a clean git state using status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then return the 40-hex HEAD SHA, mapping any git/IO/path/subprocess or malformed-output failures to store-read-failure.

All three signature-producing paths—ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review—must wire collect_plan_relation_snapshot() and pass related_material to build_manifest() before signing.
Legacy manifests with no pins must remain authenticatable and readable by existing verifiers that ignore unknown pin lines without reconstructing or rehashing a filtered manifest.
